provenance: Each pair is the IEEE 754 bits of a double (16 hex digits) and the text of the decimal the platform's own double-to-decimal conversion made of it, from a reference run of Windows PowerShell 5.1 (the .NET Framework runtime 4.0.30319.42000) on 2026-10-13: boundary cases (a 15-digit decimal with a 5 appended, the nearest double and its two neighbours), random binary and decimal magnitudes, named values, every power of two from 2^-94 to 2^95, and values read from the saves.
